Bookmarks — your own panel of devices and links

The right-hand bookmarks rail — favourites, personal folders, links shared by the team, and a live tree of every device you may see, grouped in the order you choose.

👤 ForViewerOperatorAdministrator
🔑 Permissionsusers.manage

What is it?#

The sidebar is organised the way the product is organised; the Bookmarks rail is organised the way you work. It is a tree on the right edge of every page with your favourite devices, your own folders and links, links your team has shared, and every device you may see grouped by line, zone, department or any other order you pick.

What does it do?#

The panel has four roots:

Root Contents
Favourites Everything you starred.
Folders Your personal folders and the bookmarks you filed in them.
Shared Team bookmarks nobody has filed on your panel yet.
Your grouping, e.g. Line › Zone › Department Every device you may see, nested by the dimensions you chose on your profile. Recomputed from the live inventory on every render.
  • A device bookmark follows the device's live name unless you gave it a label; its link opens the device's own management interface over HTTPS.
  • A link bookmark stores an http/https address or a page of this console (starting with /).
  • Star, Hide for me and filing into folders affect only your own panel.
  • Share with the team moves one of your bookmarks into the team scope so every user sees it.
  • Search filters the tree on the server and expands what it found.

Requirements#

  • Devices appear once registered. Device grouping uses the appliance's classification (Zone, Line, Department, Tags) and product; Network segment uses the segments defined by an administrator.

Permissions#

Every signed-in user has a bookmarks panel; no permission is needed to star, file, hide, add or delete your own bookmarks.

  • Share with the team requires write access (any permission that grants configuration writes, e.g. appliances.edit or protection.edit). Without it the share button is not shown.
  • Deleting a bookmark someone else created requires users.manage; otherwise only the author can delete it.
  • What you see is filtered by your visibility, never the sharer's: the current ADOM first, then the appliance visibility rule (maintenance devices stay hidden unless you hold appliances.view_maintenance).

How to use#

Open and close the panel#

Click the star tab on the right edge (Bookmarks). The panel starts closed; your browser remembers whether you left it open. Collapse panel closes it. A badge on the tab counts shared bookmarks waiting to be filed.

Add a bookmark#

  1. In the panel header click Add bookmark.
  2. Choose Type: Device (pick it from the list) or Link (enter the URL).
  3. Optionally type a Label — leave it empty to follow the device's live name.
  4. Click Add.

To bookmark a device straight from the device tree, click its star: SATOM creates your bookmark for it (once — starring again never duplicates it).

Organise in folders#

  1. Click New folder and type the Folder name.
  2. Drag bookmarks onto a folder. Only folders accept a drop; an empty folder says Empty — drag bookmarks here.
  3. Deleting a folder (Delete folder (its bookmarks are kept)) keeps its contents: your bookmarks return to the top level and team bookmarks to Shared.

Star, hide, share, delete#

Button Effect
Star / Unstar Add to / remove from your Favourites.
Hide for me / Unhide for me Team bookmarks only: hide it from your panel without touching anyone else's. Show hidden at the bottom reveals them.
Share with the team (moves it out of your private list) Your own non-folder bookmarks only. Asks Share this bookmark with the whole team? It leaves your private list.
Delete Author or administrator. Asks Delete this bookmark?

Search#

Type in Search devices, folders, links…. The tree is filtered on the server; matching groups keep their contents. Clear search resets it.

Change how devices are grouped#

  1. Click the sliders icon in the panel (Change how devices are grouped (your profile)), or open user menu → Profile → Bookmarks — grouping order.
  2. Choose Level 1, Level 2, … from Line, Zone, Department, Product, Network segment and Tag. Leave trailing levels at — none —.
  3. Click Save order. The page confirms "Bookmark grouping order saved." and shows Currently: with the new order.

The default order is Line › Zone › Department.

Configuration#

Field Description Required Example
Type Device or Link. Yes Device
Device A device you may see in this ADOM. For Device fweb-01
URL https://…, http://… or a console path starting with /. For Link https://wiki.example.com/runbook
Label Display name, up to 160 characters. Empty = live device name. No Shop WAF
Level 1…n Grouping dimensions, each used at most once. At least one Department

Example#

🧪Example — Filing the devices you are on call for

In Profile → Bookmarks — grouping order you set Department › Line. In the panel you create a folder On call, star the three FortiWebs you look after and drag them into it. A colleague shares a link to the incident runbook; it appears under Shared until you drag it into On call too.

Result#

  • Bookmarks are stored per user (personal) or for everyone (team), stamped with the ADOM they were created in: a bookmark created inside a product ADOM is visible in that ADOM and in Global; one created in Global is unscoped and appears in Global and in the FortiWeb ADOM (see ADOMs and products).
  • Sharing and deleting a shared bookmark are recorded in the audit log (bookmark.share, bookmark.delete).
  • Which folders are expanded and Show hidden are saved on the server against your account and follow you to another browser.

Troubleshooting#

"Your session expired — reload the page to use bookmarks."#

Possible causes — your sign-in ended; the panel received the sign-in page.

Solution — reload the page and sign in again.

"Bookmarks did not load — the server answered HTTP from . Reload the page; if it repeats, report that line."#

Possible causes — a server-side error, not an expired session. Exception: HTTP 401 means the Session Lock signed you out after inactivity (see First login).

Solution — reload once (after a 401, sign in again); if it repeats, use Report a problem and quote the line.

"CSRF token missing or expired — reload the page and retry"#

Possible causes — the panel's security token is minted when a page loads and lapses after a long idle period (for example a tab left open overnight).

Solution — reload the page and repeat the click. Nothing you filed is lost.

"only http and https links can be saved, and this one is …:"#

Possible causes — the URL uses another scheme (javascript:, data:, ftp: …). Related refusals: "the URL needs a scheme — write it out with https:// or start it with / for a page of this console", "a // URL points at another server, not at this console — write it out with https://", "the URL has no host".

Solution — enter a full https:// address or a console path starting with /.

"sharing changes what every operator sees"#

Possible causes — you tried to share without write access.

Solution — ask someone with write access to share it, or keep it personal.

"only shared bookmarks can be hidden; delete your own"#

Solution — delete your own bookmark instead of hiding it.

"folders are personal; share their contents"#

Solution — share the bookmarks inside the folder one by one.

"… appears twice. A dimension can only split the fleet once; …"#

Possible causes — the same dimension was chosen on two levels of the grouping order.

Solution — pick each dimension once. At least one level is required: "Pick at least one dimension — with none, the panel has no way to group the fleet."

A device bookmark shows "No direct link"#

Possible causes — the device's host is not a valid hostname or IP address, or its port is out of range; the tooltip gives the reason.

Solution — correct the appliance's Host / IP or Port in Appliances.

Advanced#

Advanced Storage and rules
  • A bookmark has a scope (personal or team), a kind (appliance, link, view or folder) and the ADOM it was created in. The panel's Add bookmark dialog creates device and link bookmarks; folders come from New folder.
  • Placement (folder and position), favourites and hidden flags are stored per user, so filing a team bookmark never changes anyone else's panel.
  • A device that enters maintenance drops off the panel for users who may not see it and returns where it was filed — filtering never deletes a placement.
  • Device links are always https://host[:port], derived from the appliance's current host and port, so re-addressing the device updates every bookmark.
  • Every by-ID request is resolved against the bookmarks you may see; an ID you may not see answers not found.
